Prefab.PreviewReadOnly.zh: 只读预览；当前编辑尚未提交。
Prefab.PreviewReadOnly.en: Read-only preview; edits have not been committed.

Prefab.PreviewLivePlaceholder.zh: 只读预览；实时模糊、马赛克使用静态示意。
Prefab.PreviewLivePlaceholder.en: Read-only preview; live blur and pixelation use static placeholders.

Prefab.ExportDraft.zh: 另存当前草稿为预制体

Prefab.EditConflict.zh: 工程或共享定义已改变，请保留当前编辑并重新打开定义。
Prefab.EditConflict.en: The project or shared definition changed. Retain your edits and reopen the definition.

Prefab.SourceCycle.zh: 此来源会形成循环依赖，当前内容保持不变。
Prefab.SourceCycle.en: This source would create a dependency cycle. Current content was retained.

Prefab.InstanceHint.zh: 双击编辑共享定义，修改会同步全部实例；F2 重命名此实例
Prefab.InstanceHint.en: Double-click to edit the shared definition for all instances; F2 renames this instance

Prefab.EmptyResources.zh: 从当前选择创建共享定义，或导入、链接已有文件。
Prefab.EmptyResources.en: Create a shared definition from the selection, or import or link a file.

Prefab.ResourcesHelp.zh: 同一定义的实例共享内容，各自保留位置、显隐和锁定。编辑定义会同步所有实例；解除链接才得到独立普通组。外部链接随工程保存完整快照，源文件缺失时仍可显示；更新链接会更新所有使用该定义的实例。
Prefab.ResourcesHelp.en: Instances share definition content while retaining their own placement, visibility and locking. Editing a definition updates all its instances; detach for an independent ordinary group. External links retain a complete project snapshot, so missing source files do not remove artwork. Refreshing updates every instance using the definition.

Prefab.LeaveQuestion.zh: 共享定义还有未完成的编辑。是否应用到全部实例后返回？
Prefab.LeaveQuestion.en: The shared definition has unfinished edits. Apply them to all instances and return?

Prefab.SourceLeaveQuestion.zh: 源工程还有未保存的编辑。是否保存并更新本工程的全部对应实例？
Prefab.SourceLeaveQuestion.en: The source project has unsaved edits. Save it and update all matching instances in this project?

Prefab.NotCurrent.zh: 当前工程或共享定义已经改变，请重新执行操作。
Prefab.NotCurrent.en: The project or shared definition changed. Start the operation again.

Prefab.SourceMissing.zh: 源文件无法找到，继续使用已保存快照；可重新定位或解除链接。
Prefab.SourceMissing.en: The source file is missing. The saved snapshot remains available; locate the source or detach.

Prefab.SourceUpToDate.zh: 链接源与已接受快照一致。
Prefab.SourceUpToDate.en: The linked source matches the accepted snapshot.

Prefab.SourceChanged.zh: 链接源已有更改，可更新全部对应实例。
Prefab.SourceChanged.en: The linked source changed. Refresh to update all matching instances.

Prefab.SourceSavedRefreshPending.zh: 源工程已保存；本工程仍使用旧快照，请更新链接。
Prefab.SourceSavedRefreshPending.en: The source project was saved. This project still uses its previous snapshot; refresh the link.

Prefab.LinkedReadOnly.zh: 此定义链接到外部文件。请编辑源工程，或先转为内嵌共享定义。
Prefab.LinkedReadOnly.en: This definition is linked to an external file. Edit its source project or make it embedded first.

Prefab.SourceIdentityChanged.zh: 选择的文件不是原链接资源。请使用重新定位来明确替换来源。
Prefab.SourceIdentityChanged.en: The selected file is a different resource. Use Locate source to explicitly replace it.

Prefab.ReplaceSourceQuestion.zh: 选择的文件与原链接资源身份不同。是否替换来源并更新全部对应实例？实例的位置保持不变，内容和遮挡可能改变。
Prefab.ReplaceSourceQuestion.en: This file is a different resource. Replace the source for all matching instances? Instance placement stays unchanged, but content and overlaps may change.

Prefab.LinkNeedsIdentity.zh: 此旧文件没有稳定资源身份。请先另存为新版工程，或以普通预制体导入。
Prefab.LinkNeedsIdentity.en: This older file has no stable resource identity. Save it in the current format first, or import it as embedded content.

Prefab.LinkCycle.zh: 链接会形成循环依赖，已保留当前快照。
Prefab.LinkCycle.en: The link would create a dependency cycle. The current snapshot was retained.

Prefab.NoSelection.zh: 请先选择要创建为共享定义的图层或组合。
Prefab.NoSelection.en: Select the layers or groups to turn into a shared definition.

Prefab.SharedStamp.zh: 共享预制体（本工程内同步）

Prefab.SourceEditNotSupported.zh: 请先转为内嵌共享定义以编辑此预制体。
Prefab.SourceEditNotSupported.en: Make this prefab embedded before editing it.

Prefab.DraftRestored.zh: 已恢复未完成的共享定义编辑。
